Which shortwave stations broadcast in Farsi?

In the A-26 schedule, 16 stations broadcast in Farsi. The most heavily scheduled include Radio Farda, Iran International TV, BBC, Radio Payam.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Farsi?

The most-used frequencies are 9370, 12070, 5970, 7415, 9310 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
